suppliedFiles.name: American Waste PFAS Survey -18-30% was industrial.pdf
suppliedFiles.decision: Byte-identical repeat suppressed; the claim-bearing filename was not used as source metadata.

verifiedFindings: The survey is signed May 21, 2018 by Vicki Garon as Landfill Engineer for Wexford County Landfill, LLC.
The respondent states that the landfill was currently accepting waste and that ownership began in fall 2011, limiting its knowledge of waste accepted under prior county control.
The respondent defines industrial waste broadly and estimates that industrial waste represented between 18 and 30 percent of incoming waste.

The respondent says it records generator names for waste it transports but does not necessarily have equivalent information for waste delivered by other hauling companies and does not track those shipments by SIC code or another method that could answer the requested percentages by source type.
The respondent states that it had not analyzed its leachate for PFAS as of the signed survey date.
evidentiaryBoundary: The survey records the landfill respondent's statements and an estimated overall industrial-waste share. It does not identify transaction-level deliveries, prove which industrial loads contained PFAS, provide historical records from before fall 2011, or contain leachate analytical results.

queueResolution.reason: The survey does not close the receiving-history, synchronized treatment-data, Plett receptor-series or source-to-receptor pathway requests. Its generator-record limitation reinforces why transaction-level manifests, hauler tickets, invoices and WWTP receiving logs remain necessary.
